PATCH_SECTION.description: Stored section document for the {section} path parameter. The handler validates the body with the section schema for that section.

reviewerSelectedApplicationStatus.description: The reviewer's recorded choice, not the live application status.

stateName.description: Step Functions node for this generation, such as CommitteeFromFirst or AwaitingApplicantFromSecond. status is the projection clients should display. Several nodes share one status, including the three committee nodes and the three awaiting-applicant nodes.
